# iru_custom_profile (Data Source)

Reads the configuration fields supported by iru_custom_profile for one exact existing Library Item UUID through GET only. Returns current XML, MDM identity, activation and platform flags; makes no upload, assignment or device changes. Required remote fields that are missing/null or malformed produce an error instead of empty/false values. Not-found and permission failures are errors. The single-object endpoint is not paginated.

Reads current unsigned XML, MDM identity, activation and platform flags for one
Library Item UUID. XML is sensitive and remains in state. The API representation
may include generated envelope metadata; it is not an export of the original
upload or a validation of Apple payload behavior. Required missing/null fields
fail rather than becoming false defaults.

See [configuration lookup behavior](../guides/configuration-lookups.md) for
selection, errors, nulls and sensitive state handling.

## Example Usage


```terraform
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

# Synthetic UUID: replace with an existing Custom Profile Library Item UUID.
data "iru_custom_profile" "selected" {
  library_item_id = "aaaaaaaa-bbbb-4ccc-8ddd-000000000091"
}

output "profile_name" {
  value = data.iru_custom_profile.selected.name
}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `library_item_id` (String) Exact existing Custom Profile Library Item UUID. Names and partial IDs are not accepted.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether Iru reports this Library Item as active. Reading never activates it.
- `id` (String) Canonical Custom Profile UUID.
- `mdm_identifier` (String) MDM payload identifier reported by Iru.
- `name` (String) Current Library Item display name.
- `profile` (String, Sensitive) Exact XML plist returned by Iru, including its managed envelope. Sensitive in displays but stored in Terraform state. Does not reconstruct the original upload or normalize XML.
- `runs_on_ipad` (Boolean) Whether Iru reports iPad as a target. No false default is invented for missing/null API fields.
- `runs_on_iphone` (Boolean) Whether Iru reports iPhone as a target. No false default is invented for missing/null API fields.
- `runs_on_mac` (Boolean) Whether Iru reports Mac as a target. No false default is invented for missing/null API fields.
- `runs_on_tv` (Boolean) Whether Iru reports Apple TV as a target. No false default is invented for missing/null API fields.
- `runs_on_vision` (Boolean) Whether Iru reports Apple Vision Pro as a target. No false default is invented for missing/null API fields.
